basics: Base host: Beli's Cloud Run API. Login is on a separate onboarding host; the SDK's `connect(email, password)` handles both.
Every request needs an `Origin` header (the SDK sends `https://localhost`); without it the server returns 403.
Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <access JWT>` from `POST /api/token/`. Refresh tokens are not rotated.
Framework is Django REST Framework: list endpoints return `{count, next, previous, results}`, some return `{results}` only or a bare array.
Missing required query parameters give HTTP 400 with the plain body `Missing parameters`.
Throttling: bursts return HTTP 429. Spacing writes about 5-6 seconds apart and caching search results avoided it.
Tested against app API snapshot v9.8.1. The SDK's generated parsers crash on empty 200 bodies, so use raw httpx requests (`c.get_httpx_client().request(**module._get_kwargs(...))`) for writes.

Feature flags: the app appends boolean query flags to many guide calls (`playlists_v2`, `vguides`, `supports_no_guide_category`, `supports_no_guide_city`, `supports_collab_guides`, `supports_ask_for_recs_guides[_1|_2]`, `supports_auto_bookmark`). The server hides data from callers that omit them: `/api/user-guide/` returns an empty list without them.
Guide write details marked 'from app code' were read from the decompiled Beli 10.2.0 web bundle (Capacitor/Angular app) and have not been executed.

verified.note: Email + password login returns an access/refresh token pair. 401 on a wrong password.

Query params `term` and `city` (e.g. `Tokyo, Japan`). Returns candidates with `business` id and `structured_formatting` (`main_text`, `secondary_text` address). Always check the address region, since top hits can be the wrong city.
Requires BOTH `user` (uuid) and `category` query params, otherwise 400 `Missing parameters`. Category values are Beli's three-letter codes (`RES` for restaurants).
JSON body `{user_id, business_id}`. Returns HTTP 200 with an EMPTY body, which crashes the SDK's JSON parser. 84 places bookmarked this way. Idempotent: re-adding does not duplicate.
Path-parameter endpoint. Use it to confirm a bookmark landed.
Returns the signed-in user object (id, username, name). The id/username shape may be wrapped in `results`, sometimes as a list; unwrap defensively.
Returns Beli's own curated lists (927 of them: `Top 10 LA Spanish` and so on), identical for every user_id. It is NOT the user's own guides.
Returns `{count, results}` of lists published by that user. Empty for accounts with no published lists, which is not the same as having no guides.
Returned an empty array for the tested account.

Query `user_id` plus the app's flags: `supports_no_guide_category=true&supports_no_guide_city=true&supports_collab_guides=true` (the app also sends `supports_ask_for_recs_guides`, `_1`, `_2`). Without the flags it returned an empty list. Returns each guide: `id`, `name`, `full_title`, `hscroll_title`, `subtitle`, `description`, `audience` (PUBLIC/PRIVATE), `is_draft`, `list_field`, `category`, `city`, `is_collaborative`, `collaborators`, `is_owner`, `total_count`, `can_add_items`, `can_delete`, `can_reorder`. Confirmed on a live account: 6 guides with titles.

Query `user_id` plus `supports_no_guide_category=true&supports_no_guide_city=true&supports_collab_guides=true`. Returns `{results:[{business, guide, added_by{...}}]}`, 125 items over 6 guides. `guide` is the numeric id from `/api/user-guide/`.

Creates a guide. Query flags `supports_no_guide_category=true&supports_no_guide_city=true&supports_collab_guides=true`. JSON body: `{config:{name, description, user, list_field, city_id, city_name, category, audience:'PUBLIC'|'PRIVATE', is_draft, collaborator_ids?}, user_id}`. Response has a `playlist` object (the new guide).

Edits guide fields (the app uses it for e.g. `{is_newly_unlocked:false}`). Query flags `playlists_v2=true&vguides=true&supports_no_guide_category=true&supports_no_guide_city=true&supports_collab_guides=true`. Body: the fields to change.

Edits or removes one place in a guide. Query flags `playlists_v2=true&vguides=true&supports_no_guide_category=true&supports_no_guide_city=true`. Body: `{user, business, guide, ...fields}`. Remove from guide: fields = `{end_dt: <now>}`. Change category: `{category}`. Re-add or touch: `{}`.

Adds places to guides in bulk (the app's custom-field-values call with the guide flag). Query flags `playlists_v2=true&vguides=true&supports_no_guide_category=true&supports_no_guide_city=true&supports_auto_bookmark=true`. Body: array of `{user, business, field:<guide id>, value:true, isUserGuide:true, guide:<guide id>, category}`. Response may include `auto_bookmarked_businesses`.

Full contents of one guide. Query `list_id=<guide id>&viewer=<your uuid>&check_user_access=false` plus `playlists_v2`, `vguides`, `supports_no_guide_category`, `supports_no_guide_city`. Add `refresh=true` to bypass cache. Returns `{results:[...], access}`; `access` can be `private` or `blocked`.
Query `user=<your uuid>`. City choices offered when creating a guide.
Removes a business from guides: `?user=<uuid>&business=<id>&playlists_v2=true&vguides=true&supports_no_guide_category=true&supports_no_guide_city=true`.

400 `Missing parameters` for `user`, `user_id`, and `user` + `category`. The app's equivalents are `user-guide`, `playlist-list-view` and `update-playlist/{id}/`; `playlists_v2=true` is a feature flag sent on many calls.
